note: Redline 075 (2026-10-28): the brief 075 switches for the Air sitting. NOT READ BY THE HARNESS and NOT RUN: none of these fields exists in PerfVariant (Runtime/Perf/PerfPlan.cs) or TpLongRun.RowVariant today, and JsonUtility drops unknown keys silently, so writing them into perf-072.json would run every 075 A/B as the build against itself. When Latch lands a field (both classes, Describe(), PerfSwitches.Apply/Restore, the player echoing it in its result), merge its variants and rows into briefs/072/redline/perf-072.json and tplong-072.json; run-air-072.sh already refuses a run whose resolved plan names a 075 field the player's result does not echo. Every switch is development-build only, applied once before warm-up, and off (= as built) by default, so ordinary runs replay byte-identical. See briefs/075/redline.md section 5.

fields.values: old (as built: DecoKit/Space Age Sky from light.json spaceSky) | gradient (Suborned/SkyGradient from light.json skyGradient, the sky before 075-A)
fields.how: the builder keeps the gradient sky material on the world root in development builds; the switch sets RenderSettings.skybox and calls DynamicGI.UpdateEnvironment only if the ambient source is the skybox (it is Trilight: no GI update needed). Before AtmosphereLens reads the scene sky (SceneSky caches once): switch first, then let the lens install.
fields.expected: play zoom 0 (the orthographic play frame shows no sky pixels); street level +0.05 to +0.15 ms GPU (estimate)

fields.values: dk (as built: Suborned/DK Ocean, light.json ocean) | flat (Suborned/Water, look.json water, the sea before 075-A)
fields.how: the builder keeps the Suborned/Water `water` material in development builds; the switch swaps sharedMaterial on every renderer drawing `water` (the sea quad, its sectors and the 2 builder basins) and re-applies SeaFade's centre, from, to and haze to it
fields.expected: opening 0 (no visible water; the 16 km sea quad under the land is removed by the GPU's hidden-surface removal on both sides); harbour-quay-30 +0.02 to +0.1 ms (estimate)

fields.values: lens (as built: lens.json bloomPlay 1.05 / 0.45 / 0.75) | off (bloom intensity 0 on the play camera: prices the whole bloom pass at play, which 064 A3 look item 6 wants)

fields.expected: lens against the scene grade's bloom: 0 by construction (URP's bloom cost follows resolution, downscale and max iterations, never threshold, intensity or scatter), so a lens|scene A/B is not worth a field. lens against off: the bloom pass, about 0.2 to 0.5 ms at 1080 (estimate)

passes.name: ab075
passes.why: warm, uncapped, interleaved and rotated per stop, after ab072 in the same sitting; the first segment again at the end (noise gate 3 %). ~12 min with the optional bloom variant, ~9 without
passes.rules: SetPass delta 0 for cw-base and ocean-flat; colourways at wide-lamplight-30: batches <= +40 and warm mean <= +0.1 ms; ocean at harbour-quay-30: <= +0.15 ms; bloom: report only

tplongRules: interleave with tp-street-every and tp-worst-every; colourways: module draws delta <= +260 and render thread delta <= +1.0 ms; render thread past 5 ms at tp-worst = the 32 m cell HLOD trigger (072 plan 4.3), whatever the share; sky: report only
